annotations.text:
The Decisive Moment — Instrument direction.
Near-black ground, hairline rules, IBM Plex Mono figures, one amber accent.
Static mockups for milestones M4 and M5.
The distance scale uses real Leica mark spacing — positions are linear in 1/distance, which is why the marks bunch toward infinity. Band = sharp range, index = chosen mark.
Only three settings exist here: the M6 tops out at 1/1000, so at EV 16.05 the ladder gives exactly f/8, f/11 and f/16. The alternatives row is complete, not truncated.
